capabilities: : Create question banks from CSV or images.
: Filter and track progress on question banks.
: Edit tags and categories during practice.
problem: Users need a structured way to turn raw data (CSV or images) into interactive, trackable, and spaced-repetition-based study materials within Obsidian.
summary: CSV/image-folder-based quiz practice plugin that allows users to create, practice, and track progress on question banks using spaced repetition.
